messages.text: Manufacturing engineering needs one defensible decision for test-fixture resource requirement by 2026-01-19; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside fixture qualification, calibration, rate, and ECO approval.
I found 67 HR on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0068 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000068 up to 47 HR, provided fixture qualification, calibration, rate, and ECO approval. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or defer_test_operation.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for test-operation capacity is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-069 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-068.

Required closeout records: prepare the reply in the existing email thread and leave it as a draft for review; do not send it; and post the decided option, date, constraint, alternatives, and Oracle reference in the existing operations thread. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
